name: word-bridge
description: WORD BRIDGE domain 1: V4 learning website backed by quantri.wordbridge.io.vn control plane, with two UI locales (VI/EN).

scripts.db:migrate:local: node -e "console.error('Database migrations belong to the centralized control plane; see migration instructions.');process.exit(1)"
scripts.db:migrate:remote: node -e "console.error('Database migrations belong to the centralized control plane; see migration instructions.');process.exit(1)"
scripts.test: node --test tests/unit/*.test.js tests/unit/*.test.mjs tests/integration/*.test.js tests/integration/*.test.mjs tests/e2e/*.test.js tests/e2e/*.test.mjs tests/security/*.test.mjs
scripts.lint:check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/layouts/site-layout.js && node --check public/scripts/app.js
scripts.test:legacy: node --test --test-name-pattern="End-to-End V3.1 Journey|Multi-page navigation|Curriculum Quality V3.2" tests/e2e/combined.test.mjs tests/integration/combined.test.mjs
